dashboard.label: Cyber Data Catalog - Migration and Pipeline
dashboard.description: Consolidation view: which environment each feed lives in, dual-home divergence, pipeline-level outages, and open change windows.

panel.title: Events by environment and feed status

search.query: | inputlookup dc_feeds_lookup | lookup dc_observed_lookup feed_id OUTPUT last_seen events_24h | eval flowing=if(isnotnull(last_seen) AND (now()-last_seen)<86400,1,0) | chart sum(events_24h) as events over environment by feed_status

| inputlookup dc_feeds_lookup | `dc_expected_silence` | where expected_silence="no" | lookup dc_observed_lookup feed_id OUTPUT last_seen | lookup dc_datasets_lookup dataset_id OUTPUT declared_tier | `dc_default_silence` | eval down=if(isnull(last_seen) OR (now()-last_seen)/60>max_silence_minutes,1,0) | stats sum(down) as feeds_down, count as feeds_total, dc(eval(if(down=1,uhgid,null()))) as tenants_affected by pipeline, environment | eval down_pct=round(feeds_down/feeds_total*100,1) | eval verdict=case(feeds_down>=3 AND down_pct>=50,"PIPELINE OUTAGE",feeds_down>=3,"PIPELINE DEGRADED",feeds_down>0,"isolated",1=1,"healthy") | sort - feeds_down

| inputlookup dc_feeds_lookup where feed_status="dual_home_primary" OR feed_status="dual_home_secondary" | lookup dc_observed_lookup feed_id OUTPUT events_24h last_seen | stats values(environment) as environments, values(pipeline) as pipelines, max(events_24h) as high, min(events_24h) as low, dc(environment) as env_count by dataset_id | where env_count>1 | eval divergence_pct=round((high-low)/high*100,1) | lookup dc_datasets_lookup dataset_id OUTPUT ae_name declared_tier technical_owner | eval cutover_safe=if(divergence_pct<15,"YES","NO") | table dataset_id ae_name declared_tier environments pipelines high low divergence_pct cutover_safe technical_owner | sort - divergence_pct

| inputlookup dc_pipeline_quality_lookup | lookup dc_datasets_lookup dataset_id OUTPUT ae_name declared_tier | eval checked=strftime(checked,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | table dataset_id ae_name declared_tier pipeline environment latency_p50_sec latency_p95_sec timestamp_errors_24h truncation_events_24h quality_state checked | sort - latency_p95_sec

| inputlookup dc_change_windows_lookup | eval state=case(now()<start_time,"scheduled",now()>=start_time AND now()<=end_time,"ACTIVE",1=1,"closed"), duration_hours=round((end_time-start_time)/3600,1), start_time=strftime(start_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), end_time=strftime(end_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | table window_id state scope_type scope_value start_time end_time duration_hours change_ticket expected_effect approved_by | sort state
